oracle.selection: Verify an active mainnet node before a new isolated capture; a version pin alone is not a mainnet observation. Record the actual compiler, including any difference from issue #181's go1.26.6 baseline.

query-success-errors.description: Populated-state success, decoder/handler failures and exact status/body/metadata

history-proofs-pagination.description: Matched height and committed root, proof validity, forward/reverse/key/offset pagination

broadcasts.description: Admission, inclusion, execution failure, duplicates, timeout, disconnect and retry

subscriptions.description: Events, ordering, cancellation, slow readers, reconnect and cleanup

resource-settings.description: Default/custom request/response limits, connections, deadlines, bounded allocation and capacity recovery

runtime-identity.description: Actual production node identity, build version and consensus state shape

reflection.description: Port-specific registration, versions, descriptor lookup, streams and cleanup

simulation-errors.description: Decoder, ante and execution errors, gas, details and height metadata

empty-abci-envelope.description: Actual Go URI/JSON-RPC/WS response and connection survival

pruning-restarts-indexes.description: Persistent nodes, pruning boundaries, disabled indexes, catch-up and restart

http-boundaries.description: Height headers, REST body routes, HTTP framing, batches, CORS and proxy behavior

all-api-soak.description: Bounded mixed-node soak with all transports, classified client failures and resource/progress reporting

exact.description: Compare status, stable headers/metadata, response bytes/frames and terminal status; no normalization

legacy-query-canonicalization.description: querycorpus.rs sorts selected reward/subspace/interface lists, removes Go source frames and removes GetNodeInfo application_version; this does not establish exact error or runtime build identity parity

legacy-rpc-consensus-state.description: rpc/tests/corpus.rs replaces the entire consensus_state/dump_consensus_state result; it does not verify its shape

legacy-rpc-node-identity.description: rpc/tests/corpus.rs constructs NodeInfo from the Go status, fixes catching_up=false in gRPC Status and reuses the frozen validator key

legacy-rpc-decode-error.description: rpc/tests/corpus.rs removes proto separators and Go source annotations from tx parse errors

legacy-rpc-event-order.description: rpc/tests/corpus.rs sorts event map entries in recorded event frames

known_mismatches.description: KNOWN_DIVERGENCES defers malformed bank Params and undecodable Simulate inputs; these historical assertions do not reproduce a current-release result

exclusions.description: NEEDS_CONSENSUS cases skip live-core-dependent queries; inspect the source inventory output for the current list
Existing v10.4.0 RPC and v9/v10.4 query corpora are regression-only; original fixtures lack complete source/compiler/capture hashes

Merged v10.5 packages are hash-checked in evidence-reviews.json. They remain unadmitted where an exact dependency receipt, RS binary/matched-state/response capture, complete mainnet observation or exact comparison is missing
Legacy HTTP replay invokes the Rust router in-process; it does not establish HTTP wire framing, keep-alive or production listener behavior
Historical recording used query(...).unwrap_or_default(); an empty ABCI Query envelope at /p2p/filter/other/x may appear as fabricated default success and is not evidence of public transport behavior
